mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fixture_referee_rating WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND updated_at >= #{since}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fixture_referee_rating (fixture_id, referee_name, user_id, stars, edits_used, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{fixtureId}, #{refereeName}, #{userId}, #{stars}, #{editsUsed}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT #{refereeName} AS referee_name, COALESCE(AVG(stars), 0) * 2 AS average_score, COUNT(*) AS rating_count, COALESCE(SUM(stars = 1), 0) AS star1_count, COALESCE(SUM(stars = 2), 0) AS star2_count, COALESCE(SUM(stars = 3), 0) AS star3_count, COALESCE(SUM(stars = 4), 0) AS star4_count, COALESCE(SUM(stars = 5), 0) AS star5_count FROM fixture_referee_rating WHERE fixture_id = #{fixtureId} AND referee_name = #{refereeName}
